businesses.business: engineered industrial products (aerospace sensors and process flow equipment)

offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures highly engineered industrial products in two segments: Aerospace & Advanced Technologies (sensors, connectors, fluid-handling components for aircraft and defense) and Process Flow Technologies (valves, pumps and related equipment for process industries). Sells to OEMs, aerospace and defense customers, and industrial end users.

primary_products.value: aerospace sensors; electronic connectors and fluid-handling components; industrial valves; pumps; process flow equipment

primary_services.value: aftermarket parts and repair; engineering support

customer_segment.value: B2B: aircraft and defense OEMs, chemical and energy processors, industrial plants, utilities; B2G: defense and military programs

end_markets.value: aerospace; defense; chemical processing; energy; water and wastewater; pharmaceuticals

revenue_model.value: product sales: engineered sensors, valves, pumps and components sold to OEMs and industrial users; service fees: aftermarket parts, repair and engineering support

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures engineered components and equipment from purchased materials, sold to OEMs and industrial end users; component supplier: supplies sensors and components into aircraft and defense systems

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, Asia and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: aerospace and defense sensors/components and process flow valves and pumps, all engineered industrial products

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales to OEMs and major industrial and aerospace accounts; distributors / dealers: industrial distributors and sales representatives for valves and pumps

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: aerospace certification (FAA/EASA), defense export controls (ITAR), and industrial safety and environmental standards

notes: Segment mix and recent portfolio changes may be slightly outdated.
